other_conditions: Applicant must be a Sales Emporia/Showroom.
Applicant must have its units located in Puducherry.
Applicant must be recognized by the Union Territory of Puducherry for the sale of handicrafts and micro and small enterprise products.
benefits_summary: 15% rebate on sales, up to ₹15,00,000 per annum.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
